## Summary
- migrate the file-transfer dialog visible-frame regression from the legacy branch onto current main
- keep the visible-frame assertion in the same coordinate space: `getWindowVisibleDisplayFrame` window coordinates compared with action `getLocationInWindow` bounds
- split real-window visible-frame checks from synthetic 320/640dp layout checks so simulated landscape/large-font coverage does not mix with the physical device visible frame

## Verification
- `cd baseline/AndroidClient && ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.MainActivityFileTransferSystemBoundaryContractTest --console=plain` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL, exit 0
- `cd baseline/AndroidClient && ./gradlew :app:compileDebugKotlin :app:compileDebugAndroidTestKotlin --console=plain` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL, exit 0
- `cd baseline/AndroidClient && ./gradlew :app:connectedDebugAndroidTest -Pandroid.testInstrumentationRunnerArguments.class=dev.telemachus.display.FileTransferOfferDialogLayoutInstrumentedTest --console=plain` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL, exit 0; started and finished 9 tests on P0110 - 16

## Device Evidence
- Serial: `<redacted-adb-serial>`
- Manufacturer/model/device: `nubia / P0110 / pacific`
- OS/API: `Android 16 / API 36`
- Display: `1264x2800 @ 560dpi`

## Review
- Local medium single-pass code review: no findings
- Independent read-only reviewer: no blocking findings; confirmed visible-frame comparison now uses window coordinates consistently

## Evidence Boundaries
- This is Android no-Host UI regression coverage only. It does not prove Host-backed Android/macOS file-transfer E2E bytes landing, bidirectional transfer, or Phase 0 file-transfer gate closure.
- IME overlap is not covered; these dialogs do not focus an input field or show the keyboard.
- The instrumentation uses the dialog host instead of the production immersive wrapper. It verifies the shared Material dialog content/action layout and visible-frame coordinate contract, but does not independently prove production immersive system-bar behavior.
